notes.title: Prison Alone: Content update
notes.content:
In this first update of Prison Alone, we focused on addressing the main requests made by the community! And we took the opportunity to add new content!

Check out the list of improvements:

[list]
[*] Autosave and load game system
[*] Steam Cloud Save
[*] Option to turn off realistic font for letters and documents
[*] Replacement of 13 out of 20 letters to better explain the story
[*] Repositioning of all letters and documents on the map
[*] Deactivation of already collected letters and documents
[*] Now half of the cells will remain locked
[*] Footstep volume reduced
[*] Player speed slightly increased
[*] High and Low graphic quality options
[*] Visual improvement of the Control Panel puzzle
[*] Korean language added
[*] More blood, more monsters, and more strange events!
[/list]
